identified_issues: Broken predecessor chaining between Station 1 measurement and Station 2 summary view
Absence of cryptographic provenance and session binding in Station 2 state
Data transfer relies on unpinned and unauthenticated client memory (browser local storage event)
Ungrounded claim of radiologist approval in Station 2 without cryptographic verification of the source session
evidence: Station 1 generated a cryptographic head_digest 'sha256:7f83b1...a90' for the calibrated measurement of 18.4mm
Station 2 ingested values via an unauthenticated browser local storage event without binding the Station 1 session digest
recommended_action: Refactor inter-station data transfer to require cryptographically signed payloads binding Station 1's head_digest, reject unpinned local storage events, and ensure Station 2 verifies and stores predecessor_head_digest before asserting radiologist approval.
